tagline: Enabling technology inflections for a better future
hero_kpi_rationale: The Semiconductor Systems segment, which represents 73% of revenue, is directly propelled by investments in AI and data center technologies, particularly through foundry/logic customers. It is the main structural growth driver.

ai_positioning.summary: AMAT integrates AI into its technologies and internal operations to serve the growing AI demand from its customers (data centers, servers). AI is a key growth driver but also a source of competitive and regulatory risks.
evidence: We are increasingly incorporating AI capabilities into the development of technologies, our business operations and our products and services.
Artificial intelligence (AI) and technologies related to AI are a significant demand driver for the industries we serve.
AI is evolving rapidly and the expected timing and amount of investments related to AI can change significantly.
We are exposed to risks related to the use of AI by us and our competitors.
Our customers products are used across personal computing devices, mobile phones, artificial intelligence (AI) and data center servers

kpis.name: Gross Margin

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin slightly improves despite $181M in restructuring charges, showing good operating discipline.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.description: R&D expenses increased by $337M in 2025, supported by hiring and amortization, representing 12.6% of revenue.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Capex rose to $1.8 billion in 2025, reflecting investments in production capacities and innovation.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: The company launched a plan to reduce its global workforce by approximately 4% in Q4 2025, aimed at improving productivity.

kpis.name: Foundry/Logic Mix
kpis.explanation: Measures sales proportion between foundry and logic chips, indicating revenue diversification across product lines.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Measures actual cash Applied Materials generates after investment expenses. Shows ability to distribute dividends or invest.

kpis.name: Backlog
kpis.explanation: Measures confirmed future orders not yet delivered, indicating anticipated demand and revenue visibility.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

company_description: Applied Materials, Inc. provides materials engineering solutions, equipment, services, and software to the semiconductor and related industries in the United States, China, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Southeast Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Semiconductor Systems and Applied Global Services (AGS) segments. The Semiconductor Systems segment includes semiconductor capital equipment to enable materials engineering steps, including etch, rapid thermal processing, deposition, chemical mechanical planarization, metrology and inspection, wafer packaging, and ion implantation. The AGS segment offers integrated solutions to optimize equipment and fab performance and productivity comprising spares, upgrades, services, and 200 millimeter and other equipment and factory automation software for semiconductor and other products. It serves manufacturers of semiconductor wafers and chips, and other electronic devices. Applied Materials, Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
